title: Published scoring runtime excludes unnecessary vulnerable system packages
description:
As a platform operator, I want the scoring-only container to contain only required runtime packages and pass image vulnerability gates, so that promoted artifacts do not expose avoidable operating-system attack surface.

Feature: Minimal secure scoring runtime image

Scenario: Build the scoring-only runtime
Given scoring dependencies are available as Python wheels or copied source
When the scoring runtime container is built
Then it does not install source-control, visualization, or native client packages that scoring does not execute
And the published image contains no critical or high scan findings before promotion

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Executable specification now asserts the stable Bookworm base, no apt installation in the scoring-only Dockerfile, and no Graphviz membership in the scoring runtime extra. The specification failed against the prior image definition and passes after remediation.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Board audit 2026-10-17: verified against develop. The scoring-only image (score-processor-lambda/Dockerfile.scoring-runtime) uses a digest-pinned AWS Lambda Python 3.12 base with no apt, git or Graphviz installs, and the scoring extra excludes Graphviz and openai-cost-calculator. Enforced by test_scoring_runtime_avoids_unnecessary_system_packages; the published artifact's ECR scan reported zero findings (recorded on plx-606326). There is no automated scan gate blocking promotion; ECR scan-on-push is enabled.
